$sources: ECP 201-2012 Chapter 8: 8.2 (zones, ag), 8.3 (soil classes, the elastic and design spectra of Types 1 and 2), 8.4 (importance, R), 8.5 (the equivalent static method: T, λ, the distribution), 8.6 (drift); see VERIFY.md
source: ECP 201-2012: the design spectrum Sd(T) = ag γI S [2/3 + T/TB (2.5/R - 2/3)] to TB, ag γI S 2.5/R to TC, × TC/T to TD, × TC TD/T² beyond, at least 0.20 ag γI (the EN 1998-1 form) by the generic behaviourFactor method (ag as Z, γI as I, R as q). Two spectrum types (spectrumType 1 and 2; a project chooses the other by overriding seismic.spectrumType). Entered from knowledge of the code, every value to be checked against the printed code (VERIFY.md).

B.description: Soil class B: very dense sand or gravel, very stiff clay (Type 1 spectrum)

D.description: Soil class D: loose to medium cohesionless or soft to firm cohesive soil (Type 1 spectrum)
